zh.headline: 兼具百人跨國團隊治理與 AI 原生系統實戰的技術長 (CTO) & 企業首席顧問
zh.subHeadline: 從跨國企業架構重構、生產級 AI Agent 落地，到 70–300+ 人研發組織擴張——協助董事會與 CEO 將技術投資轉化為商業護城河與實質營收。

body.text: 我是具備跨國大型企業與一線 AI 工程實戰的 Hands-on CTO 與企業技術顧問。在 AI 時代，企業不再需要只會看簡報卻不懂底層架構的傳統管理者，也不需要缺乏商業全局觀的單兵工程師。過去十餘年，我最高管理超過 300 人規模之科技與工程體系，並親自率領 70 人純軟體研發軍團交付全球頂級零售電商、跨國 CRM/ERP 中樞與高併發 AI 媒體系統；同時至今仍每天親手打造機構級量化金融智能體、雙時序大模型預測平台與邊緣運算基建。
三大高階合作模式 (Executive & Advisory Engagement)
1. 年度企業技術顧問 / Fractional CTO（一年期常駐顧問約）
專為尋求 AI 轉型、架構升級或處於高速擴張期的上市櫃企業與高成長公司設計。以年度合約（Annual Retainer）形式，每月固定參與高層技術決策、企業內部 AI Agent 生產力工作流導入、關鍵系統架構把關、雲端成本優化，以及協助 CEO 面試與考核核心技術主管。
2. 高階技術長正職 / 研發副總（CTO / VP of Engineering）
開放具前瞻願景之跨國企業、大型集團或高成長科技公司之高階技術領導職缺（Target Package: 年薪 NT$ 300萬+ / Global Executive Compensation）。全面執掌技術戰略、百人級跨國研發組織治理、高併發商業平台重構與 AI-Native 工程文化轉型。
3. 創投盡職調查與系統危機救援（Tech Due Diligence & Architecture Rescue）
為創投機構 (VC / PE)、家族辦公室與企業董事會提供融資與併購前的獨立第三方「技術盡職調查」——穿透檢視標的之代碼品質、架構擴展極限、資安合規與 AI 護城河真偽；或針對面臨高併發崩潰、嚴重技術債之核心系統提供專案診斷與重構救援。
跨國企業與旗艦實戰成績單
全球最大健康與美容零售集團（70+ 人研發軍團）：主導 SAP Commerce Cloud 高併發電商平台與微服務中台重構，扛住跨國大促銷極限流量並導入智慧化推薦與全通路庫存同步，系統可用度達 99.98%。
Fortune 500 全球消費性電子品牌（跨國系統治理）：深度整合 Salesforce Service Cloud、HubSpot、RingCentral 語音中繼與全球 ERP 庫存中樞，消滅跨部門資料孤島，將售後 RMA 退換貨流轉週期由「數天」壓縮至「數分鐘」，營運效率提升 42%。

生產級 AI Agent 與量化決策主系統（獨立架構與全端落地）：自主研發 888 StockBot 2.0 機構級金融智能體（純 TS 實作 DCF 估值、Minervini SEPA、期權損益與法人籌碼穿透）、888 StockQuant（TimesFM 與 Timestral 雙時序大模型預測）、888news 全球 AI 情報雷達、2MD 毫秒級文檔/OCR 引擎，以及高日活之 333 奇門遁甲古曆法確定性決策平台。
合作形式：一年期企業技術顧問約 (Annual Retainer)｜高階正職 (CTO / VP of Engineering)｜創投與董事會技術盡職調查 (Tech DD)。謝絕博弈、資金盤與非法灰產項目。

en.headline: Hands-On Enterprise CTO & Principal Technical Advisor: Scaling 300+ Engineering Orgs & Production AI Systems
en.subHeadline: From multinational enterprise architecture and production AI agents to leading 70–300+ person engineering organizations—helping Boards and CEOs turn technical capital into defensible business moats.

body.text: I am a hands-on Chief Technology Officer and Principal Technical Advisor combining multinational enterprise leadership with frontier AI systems engineering. Modern enterprises no longer need hands-off managers disconnected from AI architecture, nor solo coders who have never governed complex enterprise operations. Over the past decade, I have scaled organizations of 300+ staff, directly led 70-engineer software teams delivering global retail e-commerce and Fortune 500 CRM/ERP hubs, while personally architecting institutional financial AI agents, time-series foundation model platforms, and high-concurrency edge infrastructure.
Executive Engagement & Advisory Models
1. Annual Enterprise Technical Advisor / Fractional CTO (12-Month Retainer)

Designed for listed corporations, scaling tech ventures, and traditional enterprises undergoing AI transformation. Under an annual retainer, I partner directly with the CEO and Board on architecture governance, internal AI agent workflow adoption, cloud cost optimization, technical debt elimination, and hiring/vetting senior engineering leaders.
2. Full-Time Executive Leadership (CTO / VP of Engineering)

Available for high-impact Chief Technology Officer or VP of Engineering mandates (Target: Executive Compensation Package / Global Tier). Full P&L and technical ownership across multi-center engineering orgs (50–300+ engineers), high-concurrency platform modernization, and AI-Native engineering culture transformation.
3. VC / PE Tech Due Diligence & Architecture Rescue

Independent third-party technical due diligence for Venture Capital, Private Equity, Family Offices, and Corporate M&A—auditing codebase health, scalability ceilings, security posture, and AI moat authenticity before capital deployment. Also available for high-stakes architecture rescue on bottlenecked production systems.
Track Record & Flagship Production Systems

Global #1 Health & Beauty Retail Group (Led 70+ Engineers): Spearheaded SAP Commerce Cloud and event-driven microservices transformation, sustaining peak promotional concurrency across international markets with 99.98% uptime.

Fortune 500 Global Consumer Electronics Brand (Enterprise Integration): Unified Salesforce Service Cloud, HubSpot, RingCentral voice infrastructure, and ERP inventory hubs—slashing global RMA turnaround from days to minutes and boosting operational efficiency by 42%.

Self-Architected Production AI & Quantitative Systems: Built 888 StockBot 2.0 (institutional financial agent with native TypeScript DCF, Minervini SEPA, options Greeks, and institutional flow penetration), 888 StockQuant (Google TimesFM & Timestral dual foundation model forecasting), 888news (autonomous 100+ source AI intelligence radar), 2MD (sub-5ms AnyDoc & PP-OCRv4 table reconstruction engine), and 333 Qi Men Dun Jia (high-DAU deterministic astronomical rule engine & AI decision platform).
Engagement: 12-Month Advisory Retainer | Full-Time CTO / VP of Engineering | Board & VC Tech Due Diligence. Strictly no gambling, illicit crypto schemes, or unregulated exchange projects.
